title: AI Video Maker
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION AI Video Creator & Architectural Visualisation Artist Company: Arcwell Architecture Location: New Town, Kolkata Employment Type: Full-time Experience: 1–3 years preferred; talented freshers may apply About Arcwell Architecture Arcwell Architecture is a design-focused architectural firm specialising in residential, commercial, and interior design projects. We are looking for a creative and tech-savvy AI Video Creator who can transform architectural designs, 3D renders, and SketchUp models into engaging, cinematic videos using AI tools and professional video-editing software. Key Responsibilities - Create AI-generated architectural videos, cinematic walkthroughs, and project reveal videos. - Convert still renders and 3D visualisations into realistic animations using AI video-generation tools. - Create promotional reels, YouTube Shorts, Instagram videos, and other social media content. - Develop cinematic sequences featuring realistic camera movements, lighting, landscaping, people, and environmental effects. - Work with architectural drawings, SketchUp models, renders, and reference images. - Use AI tools to enhance visual quality, create transitions, and generate engaging storytelling content. - Edit videos with professional colour grading, music, sound effects, subtitles, and branding. - Create project presentations, marketing videos, and before-and-after renovation videos. - Maintain the original architectural design, building geometry, and material intent while creating animations. - Coordinate with architects and the marketing team to deliver content within deadlines. Required Skills - Knowledge of AI video-generation tools such as Kling AI, Runway, Google Veo, Luma AI, or similar platforms. - Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. - Experience with AI image-generation and enhancement tools such as Midjourney, Nano Banana, or similar platforms. - Understanding of architectural visualisation, composition, perspective, lighting, and camera movement. - Ability to create high-quality vertical reels (9:16) and cinematic videos (16:9). - Creative storytelling skills and a good understanding of social media trends. - Ability to follow architectural references accurately and maintain visual consistency across video sequences. Preferred Qualifications - Experience in an architecture, interior design, real estate, or visualisation studio. - Knowledge of SketchUp, Lumion, D5 Render, Twinmotion, V-Ray, or Unreal Engine. - Experience creating realistic exterior and interior walkthroughs. - A portfolio demonstrating AI-generated videos, architectural animations, or cinematic reels. Performance Expectations - Deliver high-quality architectural videos and social media content consistently. - Produce visually realistic, engaging, and brand-aligned content. - Demonstrate creativity while preserving design accuracy. - Meet project deadlines and respond effectively to feedback. Salary & Benefits - Salary: Based on experience, skills, and portfolio. - Opportunity to work on premium residential and commercial architectural projects. - Creative freedom to experiment with emerging AI technologies. - Professional growth in AI-assisted architectural visualisation and digital marketing. How to Apply Interested candidates should share their CV, portfolio, and links to their best AI-generated videos or architectural reels. Email: [Insert company email] Contact: [Insert contact number] Join Arcwell Architecture and turn architectural visions into cinematic experiences.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

-------------------

Requisition ID: 1747831

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY GDS FAAS (Controllership Transformation) - Senior position**

Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) professionals provide advisory services including Accounting and regulatory support for accounting change and special matters; accounting processes and controls support.

Within EY FAAS practice, the Finance Transformation Experts team build and develop client relationship with our regional stakeholders. We are part of an integrated global network of professionals who develop, design and optimise client service business processes for efficiency and high performance. We leverage and improve various frameworks, methodologies, solutions specific to our offerings and articulate presentations that communicate proposals, strategies, plans and outcomes.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

**Technical Delivery and Subject Matter Expertise -**

* Drive transformation initiatives across **Record-to-Report (R2R) processes** by leveraging deep techno-functional expertise. Lead end-to-end process improvements and strategic interventions, beyond system implementation, acting as a **transformation lead (not PMO)**.
* Own and lead transformation across key **R2R process areas**, including:
* + Revenue Recognition
  + Accruals
  + Intercompany Reconciliation
  + Manual Journal Entries and Automation
  + Asset Accounting
  + Chart of Accounts & Accounting Master Data
  + Account Reconciliation (e.g., Cash & Bank, Sales)
  + Subledger Accounting
  + Consolidation
  + Financial Statement Preparation and Filing
  + Notes and Disclosures
  + Cost Accounting & Inventory
  + Profitability Analysis
* Provide **subject matter expertise** and lead delivery teams in **R2R transformation and implementation programs**, ensuring alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Support the design and integration of **ERP platforms with AI-based solutions**, including defining and implementing AI use cases within R2R processes (especially within SAP-based environments).
* Drive **consolidation process design and execution**, including:
* + Defining consolidation data structures
  + Managing mapping between operational COA and Group COA / FS items
  + Ensuring effective use of tools such as **SAP Group Reporting, SAP BPC, Oracle FCCS**
* Lead the **workstreams or delivery teams** within large transformation programs, ensuring timely delivery, quality outcomes, and stakeholder alignment.
* Define and implement **AI-driven solutions and automation opportunities** in R2R processes, evaluating available tools and driving their practical application in enterprise environments.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

  

**Business Development & Solution Development -**

* Lead pursuit teams to understand client problem statements & formulate that in solutions
* Lead developing client specific solutions for the engagement team
* Lead proposal development or lead proposal teams
* Lead collaboration with market teams to develop relationship and drive business growth for EY
* Collaborate cross service lines to ensure smooth execution of the project.
* Lead development of internal capability development and lead training sessions to coach internal teams to develop capability
* Lead operational initiatives within the practice areas.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

**Subject Matter and Technical Skills -**

* Deep knowledge in Record to report, invoice to pay and Order to cash areas
* Certification and/or sound experience based knowledge in ERPs like SAP S/4 HANA FI/CO/COPA, SAP Central Finance, Oracle Fusion Finance, Oracle Netsuite
* Certification and/or sound experience based knowledge in digital finance solutions like Blackline, Trintech, High Radius, Different RPA solutions
* Knowledge about AI/ML/Gen-AI & Analytics solution in finance space particularly in Record to Report areas.
* Knowledge of consolidation, reporting, inter-company and ERP data structures
* Have experience in current state analysis (As is), future state analysis (To be), process optimization, data optimization, data analytics, data management

  

**Business Skills and Knowledge –**

* Strong business development skills
* Very strong solution conceptualization/ideation skill
* Strong solution/product build skills
* Strong project management skills

  

**Human Skills –**

* Excellent written & oral communication & articulation
* Flexible work attitude
* Proven ability to lead diverse team over multiple geographies
* Strong collaboration skills
* Ability to comprehend complexity quickly & apply solutions
* Comfort in dealing with ambiguity
* Strong entrepreneurial skills in terms of ownership of problem & solutions
* Strong problem solving skills
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure and deliver results
* Willingness to travel for short or long duration at short notice

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* CA, MBA (Finance) with Commerce Background, CWA, CMA, CFA, M.Com
* 2-4 Years of relevant consulting experience in record to report transformation (not Industry user experience)
* Experience of working with international clients preferred
* Experience with previous multinational consulting firms or Big4 firms

  

**What working at EY offers**

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics -Consultant — Collibra Data Intelligence Platform-GIG**

EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.

  

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for an experienced Data Governance Consultant with deep, hands-on expertise in the **Collibra Data Intelligence Platform** to lead the design, implementation and adoption of data governance capabilities across the enterprise. You will work directly with data owners, stewards, architects and business stakeholders to translate governance policy into a working Collibra implementation — operating model, metadata, lineage, workflows and data quality — and make it something the business actually uses.

This is a hands-on delivery role with strong client and stakeholder exposure. You will be equally comfortable configuring the platform and standing in front of a steering committee explaining why it matters.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead end-to-end implementation and configuration of the Collibra Data Intelligence Platform, including operating model design, communities, domains, asset types, relations, complex attributes and scopes.
* Design and build **Collibra workflows** (BPMN / Groovy) for data steward approvals, issue management, access requests and onboarding processes.
* Configure and manage the **Collibra Data Catalog**, business glossary, reference data and policy management modules.
* Implement technical and business lineage using **Collibra Lineage Harvester, Edge** and custom lineage ingestion.
* Integrate Collibra with enterprise source systems, data platforms and BI tools using the Collibra REST APIs, Edge connectors, Catalog connectors and JDBC ingestion.
* Define and operationalise data governance frameworks: roles and responsibilities, stewardship models, data ownership, policies and standards.
* Establish metadata ingestion pipelines and automate bulk metadata onboarding via APIs and import templates.
* Define and track data quality rules, KPIs and dashboards; support remediation of data quality issues with the relevant data owners.
* Support platform administration: user and group management, roles and permissions, environment promotion and release management.
* Run workshops, training and enablement sessions for stewards and business users to drive platform adoption.
* Produce solution design documents, configuration guides, runbooks and handover documentation.
* Provide advisory input on governance roadmap, maturity assessments and best practice to senior stakeholders.

  

**REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* **8+ years** of overall experience in data management, data governance or enterprise data platforms.
* **Proven, hands-on proficiency with the Collibra Data Intelligence Platform** — not just usage, but design and configuration across multiple implementations.
* Strong command of the Collibra operating model: asset types, domains, communities, attributes, relations, hierarchies and validation rules.
* Practical experience building and troubleshooting Collibra workflows (BPMN, Groovy scripting).
* Experience with Collibra Catalog, Business Glossary, Data Lineage, Data Helpdesk and Policy Manager.
* Working knowledge of Collibra Edge, Lineage Harvester and connector-based metadata ingestion.
* Solid experience with the Collibra REST API for automation, bulk operations and system integration.
* Strong SQL and a good understanding of data modelling, metadata management and data architecture concepts.
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks, data privacy and regulatory drivers (e.g. GDPR, BCBS 239, CCPA).
* Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation and written communication skills — able to work with both engineering teams and business leadership.
* Linux skills to manage the on-premise server components

  

**DESIRABLE SKILLS**

* **Collibra Data Quality (DQ)** — rule authoring, DQ job configuration, scorecards, and integration of DQ results back into the Collibra Data Catalog.
* **Python** — for API automation, metadata ingestion scripts and data quality validation.
* **Git** — version control for workflow artefacts, scripts and configuration-as-code; familiarity with branching strategies and CI/CD pipelines.
* **Snowflake** — cataloguing and lineage from Snowflake
* Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure) and modern data stack tooling (dbt, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Databricks).
* Experience with other governance or DQ tools (Informatica, Alation, Ataccama, Great Expectations) for comparative context.
* API Development with Spring Boot
* Consulting background with experience running client-facing engagements and pre-sales support.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field.
* **Collibra Ranger / Collibra Expert certification** strongly preferred (e.g. Collibra Certified Ranger, Data Steward, or Workflow Developer).

Certifications in Snowflake, cloud platforms or DAMA CDMP are an advantage.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. title: QA senior lead
description:
QA Senior Lead (Contract/FTE) Experience: 11–15 Years Company \- LTI Mindtree Location: Kolkata Budget: As per Market Standards Role Overview We are looking for a QA Senior Lead to lead quality assurance for a large\-scale, cloud\-native media content platform handling massive volumes of media data including articles, videos, and audio. The role will focus on API testing, data validation, automation, performance testing, and QA strategy, while leading the team and driving quality across the complete data lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Lead and mentor QA engineers and define the overall QA strategy. Drive Shift\-Left testing and integrate quality practices across the SDLC. Own end\-to\-end testing for data ingestion, processing, storage, and API consumption. Test ingestion workflows, SNS/SQS, scheduled jobs, and REST APIs including keyword, category, and semantic search. Perform large\-scale validation of JSON datasets using AWS S3, Athena, SQL, and Glue Crawlers. Validate metadata, mappings, date logic, filtering, and data accuracy across multiple sources. Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks using JavaScript/Jest and/or Python/Pytest. Integrate API automation and JSON schema validation into CI/CD pipelines. Design and execute high\-volume load and performance testing using Locust. Analyse bottlenecks across ALB, ECS, downstream services, API latency, and search performance.
